units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:9">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>רחם … וס׳</he> fell in love with a woman …, and became dangerously ill.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:4:7">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᵈ</cite> bot. Y. Ab. Zar. l. c. <he>ומשתי ולא יִסְכַּן</he> and let him drink it, that he may not get ill. Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ <he>בעינה סַכְנַת</he> she was in danger of losing her eye-sight; <he>בימה ס׳</he> she was in danger of drowning &c., v. <cite ref="O00923">preced.</cite>
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:13">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> <he>וסַכְנָן נפשתא</he> (not <he>וסכנתן</he>) human lives were in danger; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to expose to danger; to hurt; to mislead, bring into trouble.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 25b:24">Ber. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>סַכַּנְתּוּן לברי</he> you might have brought my son into trouble (by causing him to sin unawares).

<cite ref="Shabbat 116a:10">Sabb. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>בעו לסַכּוּנֵיה</he> they tried to give him trouble; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M01948"><he>מְסַכַּן</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="M01950"><he>מְסַכְּנָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 22:5">Targ. II Sam. XXII, 5</cite>.—Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ top <he>עד דהוא מצמית לון הוא מס׳</he> until he gets them together for a meeting, he might be in danger (of starving).

senses.gloss: to be exposed to danger, be hurt; to be in trouble.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 25:3">Targ. Y. Deut. XXV, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 119:109">Targ. Ps. CXIX, 109</cite>.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 112b">Pes. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>וא׳ ליה</he> and he might be injured; <cite ref="Pesachim 112b:10">ib.</cite> <he>ומִסְתַּכֵּן</he>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 61a:13">Keth. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>אי לאו … אִסְתַּכְּנִי</he> if he had not given it to me, I should have become seriously ill; a. e.
